captions.facebook:
WhatsApp is quietly testing something new for a small group of users: the ability to add your own third-party AI agent right into a chat.

Up to 5 agents, each kept in its own separate conversation. It could turn the app you already use every day into a home for AI helpers.

But there's a catch. Your personal WhatsApp chats stay end-to-end encrypted, but agent chats run through a secure Meta service instead, since an outside developer's agent needs to read and reply.

Would you add an AI agent to your WhatsApp, knowing that?

#ai #whatsapp #aiagents #privacy

youtube.title: WhatsApp AI Agents: What They Can (and Can't) See
youtube.description:
WhatsApp is testing a way to add your own third-party AI agent into a chat, up to 5 at once, each boxed into a separate conversation.

This Short covers how to set one up, what the agent can and can't see on your phone, and the privacy detail worth knowing: agent chats aren't end-to-end encrypted the way your personal chats are, since they run through a secure Meta service for the agent's developer.

It's early testing on iOS and Android, so features and limits can still change before a wider rollout.

#whatsapp #aiagents #ai #metaai #privacy

slides.title: WhatsApp is testing your own AI agent inside a chat
slides.sub: Up to 5 agents, each in its own separate chat.
slides.voiceover: WhatsApp is quietly testing a way to add your own AI agent into a chat.

slides.label: NEW TEST
slides.title: Up to 5 third-party agents per account
slides.sub: Each agent gets its own separate chat, kept apart from the rest.
slides.voiceover: You'll be able to connect up to five third-party agents at once.

slides.label: HOW TO ADD ONE
slides.title: Setting up an agent takes three steps
steps: find the new `Agents` section in WhatsApp
give the agent an identity, like a contact
paste the API key WhatsApp generates into the agent's platform
slides.voiceover: Setting one up takes three steps: settings, a name and photo, then an API key.

slides.label: WHAT IT CAN SEE
slides.title: Each agent is boxed into its own chat
items: only what you share inside that one chat
your other chats, contacts or media
slides.voiceover: An agent only sees the one chat you gave it, nothing else on your phone.

slides.label: THE CATCH
slides.title: Agent chats are not end-to-end encrypted
items: Your personal WhatsApp chats stay end-to-end encrypted
Agent chats run through a secure Meta service on behalf of the agent's developer
That's the tradeoff for letting an outside agent read and reply
slides.cta: Know what you share before you connect one.

slides.label: WHY IT MATTERS
slides.title: WhatsApp is becoming a home for AI agents
items: your agents live where you already chat, no new app
testing now with a limited number of users on iOS and Android
features and limits can still change before a wider rollout
slides.voiceover: It's early testing, but it turns your chat app into a hub for AI agents.

slides.title: Your favorite AI agent could soon live inside WhatsApp.
slides.title2: Just know it's not private the way your chats are.
